code: library(L0glm) # \donttest{    ## ------------------------------------------------------------------------ ## 1  Simulate a blurred spike-train with a BIGAUSSIAN PSF & Poisson noise ## ------------------------------------------------------------------------ library(Matrix) library(splines) set.seed(123) family <- poisson(identity)  ## --- true point-spread function (PSF) ----------------------------- L       <- 51                       # kernel length sigma1  <- 1.25                     # left-hand sigma sigma2  <- 5                        # right-hand sigma g_true  <- convkernel("bigaussian", L,                       params = list(sigma1 = sigma1,                                     sigma2 = sigma2),                       perc   = "mean") # match the fitted PSF's centroid convention  ## --- latent sparse spike-train ------------------------------------ n        <- 10000L                  # timepoints npeaks   <- 1000L                   # nonzero peaks idx      <- sample(n, npeaks) amps     <- sample(1000:100000, npeaks) a_true   <- numeric(n);  a_true[idx] <- amps   # true spikes  ## --- baseline ----------------------------------------------------- baseline <- "intercept" # or "bspline" or NULL if (!is.null(baseline)) {if (baseline=="intercept") {   X_baseline <- Matrix::Matrix(1, n, 1, sparse = TRUE)   a_baseline <- 5000 } else if (baseline=="bspline") {   nknots <- max(4L, floor(n/500))   X_baseline <- splines::bs(seq_len(n), df = nknots, degree = 3)   X_baseline <- Matrix::Matrix(X_baseline, sparse = TRUE)   a_baseline <- runif(nknots, min = 2000, max = 6000) }} else { X_baseline <- NULL }  ## --- generate blurred, noisy observations ------------------------- X_sim  <- convmatrix(g_true, n) if (!is.null(X_baseline)) { X_full <- cbind(X_baseline, X_sim) a_full <- c(a_baseline, a_true) y_baseline <- as.vector(X_baseline %*% a_baseline) # noiseless baseline } else {   X_full <- X_sim   a_full <- a_true   y_baseline <- rep(0, n) }  y_true <- as.vector(X_full %*% a_full)    # noiseless convolution y      <- rpois(n, y_true)                # with Poisson noise  # quick sanity plot plot(y, type = "l", ylim = c(0,max(y)),      main = "Simulated blurred spike train with baseline in red") lines(y_baseline, col="red")  ## ------------------------------------------------------------------------ ## 2  Blind deconvolution starting from intial Gaussian PSF guess ## ------------------------------------------------------------------------ g0 <- convkernel("gaussian", L, list(sigma = 6))  # initial guess for PSF  fit <- L0glm_blind_deco(y,                         family = poisson(identity),                         L = L,                 # PSF kernel length                         baseline = baseline,                         kernel_est = g0,                         kernel_smoothfun = function(y) {                           log_conc_smooth(y, nknots = round(L / 5))                         },                         perc = "mean",         # use centroid centering                         kernel_true = g_true,  # for plots                         IC = "gic",                         plot = TRUE,                         tol = 1e-3)  plot(fit$deviance_trace, type="l", log="y",      xlab="Iteration", ylab="Deviance",      main="Poisson L0 glm blind deconvolution\nconvergence behaviour") a_est = as.vector(fit$a_hat)   # estimated spikes g_est = fit$g_hat              # estimated PSF  ## ---------- summary statistics ------------------------------------ n_true <- sum(a_true != 0) n_est  <- sum(a_est  != 0) tp     <- sum(a_true != 0 & a_est != 0) precision <- tp / n_est recall    <- tp / n_true F1        <- 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall) R2p <- 100 * summary(lm(a_true ~ 0 + a_est))$r.squared  ## ---------- scatter-plot with true vs. estimated peak areas ------- main_expr <- bquote(   atop("Poisson L0 glm blind deconvolution",        atop("true vs. estimated peak areas",             italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.2f", R2p)) * "%" ~ "|" ~               "peaks:" ~ .(n_true) ~ "(true)," ~ .(n_est) ~ "(est.)" ~ "|" ~               "F1 =" ~ .(sprintf("%.2f", 100 * F1)) * "%"))) plot(a_est, a_true,      xlim = range(a_est, a_true),      ylim = range(a_est, a_true),      pch  = 16, col = "blue",      xlab = "estimated value",      ylab = "true value",      main = main_expr)  # Multichannel fits use an individual background offset for each channel. Y <- cbind(y, rpois(n, 0.7 * y_true), rpois(n, 1.3 * y_true)) multi <- L0glm_blind_deco(Y, family = poisson(identity), kernel_est = g0,                          baseline = "bspline", nknots = 6L,                          maxiter = 3L, plot = FALSE) dim(multi$a_hat) multi$deviance  # Estimate smoothly varying PSFs in ten overlapping windows. # The returned X can also be supplied to splogconNMF(). varying <- L0glm_blind_deco(y, family = poisson(identity), kernel_est = g0,                            baseline = "bspline", nknots = 8L,                            nwindows = 10L, maxiter = 6L) dim(varying$g_hat)  # 10 local PSFs dim(varying$X)      # sparse scan-by-scan design # }

code: library(L0glm) ## ------------------------------------------------------------------------ ## 1  Simulate a blurred spike-train with a BIGAUSSIAN PSF & Poisson noise ## ------------------------------------------------------------------------ library(Matrix) library(splines) set.seed(123) family <- poisson(identity)  ## --- true point-spread function (PSF) ----------------------------- L       <- 51                       # kernel length sigma1  <- 1.25                     # left-hand sigma sigma2  <- 5                        # right-hand sigma g_true  <- convkernel("bigaussian", L,                       params = list(sigma1 = sigma1,                                     sigma2 = sigma2),                       perc   = 0)   # already centred  ## --- latent sparse spike-train ------------------------------------ n        <- 500L                    # timepoints npeaks   <- 50L                     # nonzero peaks idx      <- sample(n, npeaks) amps     <- sample(1000:100000, npeaks) a_true   <- numeric(n);  a_true[idx] <- amps   # true spikes  ## --- baseline ----------------------------------------------------- baseline <- "intercept" # or "bspline" or NULL  if (!is.null(baseline)) {if (baseline=="intercept") {   X_baseline <- Matrix::Matrix(1, n, 1, sparse = TRUE)   a_baseline <- 5000 } else if (baseline=="bspline") {   nknots <- max(4L, floor(n/500))   X_baseline <- splines::bs(seq_len(n), df = nknots, degree = 3) X_baseline <- Matrix::Matrix(X_baseline, sparse = TRUE)   a_baseline <- runif(nknots, min = 2000, max = 6000) }} else { X_baseline <- NULL }  ## --- generate blurred, noisy observations ------------------------- X_sim  <- convmatrix(g_true, n) if (!is.null(X_baseline)) { X_full <- cbind(X_baseline, X_sim) a_full <- c(a_baseline, a_true) y_baseline <- as.vector(X_baseline %*% a_baseline) # noiseless baseline   } else {    X_full <- X_sim   a_full <- a_true   y_baseline <- rep(0, n) }  y_true <- as.vector(X_full %*% a_full)    # noiseless convolution y      <- rpois(n, y_true)                # with Poisson noise   # quick sanity plot plot(y, type = "l", ylim = c(0,max(y)), main = "Simulated blurred spike train with baseline in red") lines(y_baseline, col="red")  ## ------------------------------------------------------------------------ ## 2  Deconvolution with the known PSF ## ------------------------------------------------------------------------  fit <- L0glm_sparse_deco(y, kernel = g_true,                          family = poisson(identity),                          baseline = baseline,                           IC = "gic") a_est_baseline <- as.vector(fit$coef_baseline)  a_est <- as.vector(fit$coef_spikes) sum(a_est!=0)   ## ---------- summary statistics ------------------------------------ n_true <- sum(a_true != 0) n_est  <- sum(a_est  != 0) tp     <- sum(a_true != 0 & a_est != 0) precision <- tp / n_est recall    <- tp / n_true F1        <- 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall) R2p <- 100 *   summary(lm(a_true ~ 0 + a_est))$r.squared R2p  ## ---------- scatter-plot with true vs. estimated peak areas ------- main_expr <- bquote(   atop("Poisson L0-glm deconvolution with known PSF",        atop("true vs. estimated peak areas",             italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.2f", R2p)) * "%" ~ "|" ~               "peaks:" ~ .(n_true) ~ "(true)," ~ .(n_est) ~ "(est.)" ~ "|" ~               "F1 =" ~ .(sprintf("%.2f", 100 * F1)) * "%")))  plot(a_est, a_true,      xlim = range(a_est, a_true),      ylim = range(a_est, a_true),      pch  = 16, col = "blue",      xlab = "estimated value",      ylab = "true value",      main = main_expr)  # Fit several outcome channels jointly, with their own baseline coefficients. Y <- cbind(y, rpois(n, 0.7 * y_true), rpois(n, 1.3 * y_true)) multi <- L0glm_sparse_deco(Y, kernel = g_true, family = poisson(identity),                           baseline = "bspline", nknots = 6L) dim(multi$coef_spikes) dim(multi$coef_baseline)
